summary: Tested P0 fixes for MoneySutra: Reports page date range UI (duplicate 'To' label fix) and SIP auto-update scheduler. Both features working correctly.

minor.issue: Error processing due premiums: time data '1' does not match format '%Y-%m-%d' - some insurance premium dates may be stored incorrectly

updated_files: /app/backend/server_models.py - Added lastSipUpdateDate field to Investment model
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user: test@moneyssutra.com / test
context_for_next_testing_agent: SIP auto-update feature fully tested. Bitcoin Daily SIP was auto-updated by scheduler on startup (45000 -> 45100). Investment model updated to include lastSipUpdateDate field.

reports_date_range_ui.details: Verified Reports page (/insights/reports) has exactly 1 FROM label and 1 TO label above the date inputs. No duplicate 'To' span found. Date inputs have correct data-testid attributes.

trigger_sip_update_endpoint.details: POST /api/investments/trigger-sip-update returns correct response with date, totalSipInvestments (8), updatedToday count, and details array. Each SIP has isDueToday correctly computed based on frequency.

bitcoin_daily_sip_auto_update.details: Bitcoin (BTC) Daily SIP was auto-updated by scheduler on startup. currentValue=45100 (was 45000 + 100 sipAmount). lastSipUpdateDate=2026-03-01 correctly set.

monthly_sip_not_due_march_1.details: Monthly SIPs with selectedDate=5 (HDFC RD, PPF) and selectedDate=10 (Axis Bluechip, NPS Tier 1) correctly show isDueToday=false on March 1st.

weekly_sip_not_due_sunday.details: Nifty 50 ETF (Weekly/Monday) correctly shows isDueToday=false on Sunday.

scheduler_runs_on_startup.details: Backend logs confirm scheduler runs auto_update_sip_investments on startup as part of daily checks.

investment_crud_still_works.details: GET, POST, DELETE for investments all working correctly after adding trigger-sip-update endpoint.

code_fix_applied.change: Added lastSipUpdateDate: Optional[str] = None to Investment model (line 427)
code_fix_applied.reason: Investment model had extra='ignore' which was stripping lastSipUpdateDate from API responses. Now the field is properly included.
